notes:
Quick Level this cue: one button at the top of the right panel. It levels the selected cue, switches to Levelled so you hear it, and shows before and after.
Even out (on by default): loud or quiet stretches, like one speaker much louder than the rest, are brought within about 2 dB with clip gain before levelling. Volume only; edit or remove them under Clip gain. Switch it off for music.
Even out button in the clip gain editor; automatic sections are marked "auto".
The top-bar switch is now called Level on drop.
